findings.title: Nested-worktree position breaks chain resolution; canonical position fully green
findings.detail: In .review-zr803-clean the lock test fails because PROJECT_ROOT.parent/filing-fetch resolves inside revenue-forecast (no such sibling there); re-run from MAIN repo per protocol: 6/6 passed. Classified positional per review instructions, not a regression. Worktree git status stayed clean throughout.

findings.title: Assert-message path crashes on str.stderr.decode (text=True)
findings.detail: tests/test_zr803_chaos_recovery.py:119 evaluates proc.stderr.decode('utf-8','replace') although run() uses text=True, so a real lock-journey failure surfaces as AttributeError instead of the actual stderr (observed live during worktree run). Diagnostic-only defect: the assert itself still fails, so no false-pass is possible.

findings.title: Module docstring overclaims duplicate-create coverage in ordering test
findings.detail: Docstring (lines 19-20) claims 'duplicate create are refused' but the ordering test body only pins evaluate-before-create refusal plus recovery. Duplicate-create refusal is pinned by the existing owner tests/test_backtest.py:164-166 (second write_new_json raises FileExistsError) — cross-reference verified, card AC 'per fault class idempotent recovery' remains covered.
